newsitem.title: UK: Jerry Hall -- top model turned rock star's wife.
newsitem.headline: Jerry Hall -- top model turned rock star's wife.

text.p: Jerry Hall, wild-child Texan supermodel turned rock star's wife and society hostess, has captured the spotlight again after media stories that her marriage to Mick Jagger is on the rocks.
Hall, 40, is reported to have consulted Princess Diana's divorce lawyer Anthony Julius, having run out of patience with the Rolling Stone singer's alleged affairs with other women.

A split would end one of the longest-running and most glamorous relationships in the rock world -- and give willowy Hall a hefty share of Jagger's reported 100 million pounds ($160 million) fortune, British newspapers said.
The couple have been together, and rarely out of the headlines, since 1978 when Hall left Roxy Music's Bryan Ferry for Jagger, who divorced first wife Bianca to make way for her.

The couple finally married in 1990, on the Indonesian island of Bali. Their relationship has always been overshadowed by tabloid tales of Jagger's sexual straying, including a near terminal rupture after his fling with an Italian model in 1992.

In the years since the glamorous cover model fell for Jagger's charm Hall has had three children -- a boy and two girls -- and adopted a high-society lifestyle based in a $2.5 million mansion in south-west London.
Her hobbies include riding, gardening and watching polo matches with Jagger's aristocratic friends -- unexpected interests for the daughter of a hard-drinking Texan truck driver.
While Hall has worked hard at adapting to English country life she says her toughest task has been keeping Jagger from straying into the arms of other beautiful young women.

"My theory is, the more you let 'em go, the more they come back. You can't take anything for granted in a relationship," she told an interviewer earlier this year, "because after all these years girls are still chasing after him."

But the woman who spoke at Oxford University in favour of the motion that "This House believes in exploiting its assets" -- and was never shy in flaunting her own charms -- may have lost her appetite for the competition.

Hall says she never expected her relationship with Jagger to last more than two years. But she pursued their life together with the same energy that rocketed her to fame after she was discovered by a talent scout on a beach in the south of France.

She became a big-league model in the late seventies and won a reputation for wild off-catwalk behaviour, which continued into the early 80's when she reportedly had an affair with billionaire Robert Sangster.
Unlike some whose employability fades with their youth Hall, with her trademark long blonde hair, has kept working and has branched out into acting, swimwear design and producing an exercise video.
